map.依据无障碍设计规范，计算门洞、走廊最小净宽与轮椅回转空间直径，辅助居家改造: Per accessibility design codes, compute minimum clear width of doorways/corridors and wheelchair turning diameter, aiding home modification.
map.居家与公共空间适老化改造中，需按轮椅类型核算门洞、走廊、转弯的最小净宽。: In age-friendly home/public-space renovations, verify min clear width of doors, corridors, and turns by wheelchair type.
map.手动/电动/护理轮椅宽度不同，协助推行还需更宽以便并行。: Manual/electric/care wheelchairs differ in width; assisted pushing needs extra width for side-by-side.
map.门洞应测『门扇全开后的实际通行净宽』，而非门框尺寸。: Measure the 'actual clear width with the door fully open', not the frame size.
map.：手动轮椅宽约 680 mm；门洞场景最小净宽建议 ≥ 800 mm（单侧操作余: : Manual wheelchair ≈680 mm wide; doorway min clear width ≥800 mm (≈60mm one-side allowance), prefer sliding/outward-opening doors to maximize passage.
map.：走廊自行推行最小净宽 ≥ 1200 mm；若需护理员并行协助，则 ≥ 1500: : Self-pushed corridor min clear width ≥1200 mm; with a carer side-by-side ≥1500 mm; doors or corners also recommend 1500 mm. Electric ≈700 mm, care ≈740 mm, same rule.
map.轮椅通道宽度取多少？: What wheelchair passage width to use?
map.门洞 ≥ 800 mm、走廊自行 ≥ 1200 mm、协助并行 ≥ 1500 m: Doorway ≥800 mm, self corridor ≥1200 mm, assisted parallel ≥1500 mm, turning space ≥1500 mm (common age-friendly rule; follow latest code). Chair body 680–740 mm wide needs extra operating margin.
map.为什么门洞要测实际通行净宽？: Why measure actual clear width for doorways?
map.门框尺寸含门扇厚度与五金，门扇开启后真正可通行宽度更小；推拉门/外开门能显著增加: Frame size includes leaf thickness and hardware; the truly passable width after opening is smaller; sliding/outward doors significantly increase effective clear width, so use 'post-open clear width'.
